narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>A design with no line of symmetry has no symmetry at all.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Turn a design of two tiles a half turn about its middle, and look closely. It fits.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Fold lines are only one test. The turn test can pass when the fold test fails.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble says a design with no line of symmetry has no symmetry at all; a design of two tiles is tried with several fold lines and none works, then it turns a half turn and fits; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='fold'/>To check your own design, fold it and see whether the halves match.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Then turn it and see whether it fits. If either test passes, your design is symmetric.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the recap board shows the check: fold the design and see if the halves match; turn the design and see if it fits

old_misconception.wrong_answer: a design with no line of symmetry has no symmetry at all
old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu says a design with no line of symmetry has no symmetry at all. Turning the design a half turn makes it fit its own outline, so the bubble is struck.
